title: Cloudsley Cellars
specs: Small-lot, terroir-driven Pinot Noir and Chardonnay from the Twenty Mile Bench in Niagara
includes: Free tastings at the winery for up to four people (club members)
blurb: Cloudsley Cellars produces small-lot Pinot Noir and Chardonnay wines from the Twenty Mile Bench in Niagara. They offer a wine club with quarterly shipments of exclusive and limited production wines. The winery is open for tastings seasonally and offers free delivery in Ontario on orders over $200.
extraNote: Free delivery in Ontario on orders of $200 or more · Winery closes for the season on October 31; limited tastings offered in Fall/Winter · 3795 Victoria Avenue, Vineland, ON L0R 2C0 · Open for tastings until October 31; limited tastings in Fall/Winter
